title: Gravediggers in Hamlet
html_source: Bloom forgives himself for thinking about jokes at a funeral, which puts him in mind of Hamlet Act V, Scene I, where two gravediggers referred to by Shakespeare as “clowns” joke back and forth while digging a grave.
